Q.name: Noxious Blast
Q.title: Template:Data Cassiopeia/Noxious Blast
Q.wikitext:
{{{{{1|Ability data}}}|Noxious Blast|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}} |champion = Cassiopeia |skill = Q |icon = Noxious Blast.png |blurb = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Cassiopeia}} blasts an area with {{tip|Poison}} after a brief delay, dealing {{as|magic damage}} over time to enemies hit.
She gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} if she hits an enemy {{tip|champion}}. |description = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Cassiopeia''' creates a blast at the target location that explodes after a {{fd|0.4}}-second delay. Enemies within the blast are {{tip|poison|poisoned}} for 3 seconds, taking {{as|magic damage}} every {{ap|3/7|round=3}} seconds over the duration. |leveling = {{st|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|65 to 205}} {{as|(+ 75% AP)}}|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{ap|65/7 to 205/7|round=2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|75/7|round=2}}% AP)}}}} |description2 = If ''Noxious Blast'' hits an enemy {{tip|champion}}, '''Cassiopeia''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that decays over 3 seconds. |leveling2 = {{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|30 to 50}}%}} |target range = 850 |effect radius= {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 200 |cooldown = {{fd|3.5}} |cast time = {{fd|0.25}} |cost = {{ap|50 to 70}} |costtype = mana |targeting = Location |affects = Enemies |damagetype = Magic |spelleffects = aoedot |spellshield = True |projectile = |knockdown = |grounded = |outofrange = walk to location |notes = * ''Noxious Blast'' always uses [[quick cast]], regardless of player settings. * The damage inflicted by ''Noxious Blast'' is calculated as follows: damage / 7 ticks rounded down to the nearest integer. ** For example: with {{as|0 '''bonus''' AP}} ''Noxious Blast'' inflicts 75 damages over 7 ticks of damage, so 75/7 (≈10.71) deals first of all 10 damage, then (2{{times}}75/7) {{minus}} 10 (≈11.43) deals in a second time 11 damages, then (3{{times}}75/7) {{minus}} 10 {{minus}} 11 (≈11.14) deals in a third time 11 damages, and so on. * The damage displayed for ''Noxious Blast'' DOT ([[Damage_over_time]]) always remains constant and corresponds to the previously mentioned formula: damage / 7 ticks rounded down to the nearest integer. It's important not to confuse the consistent displayed damage with the actual damage, which is updated with each tick, see [[tick and updates]]. ** With the same example as above, the damage displayed is always 10. * Occasionally, ''Noxious Blast'' may not deal the displayed damage. This discrepancy occurs when the calculated damage falls between 0.5 and 1. In such cases, rounding to the nearest integer, specifically rounding up, creates a 1-point difference. It's important to note that the damage is rounded down to the nearest integer. ** For example: with a {{iis|Blasting Wand}}, ''Noxious Blast'' shows {{ap|75 + {{as|90% of 45}} = 115,5 magic damage}} so rounded to the nearest integer {{ap|116 magic damage}}, but really deals using the formula above {{ap|115 magic damage}}. * {{bug}} When '''Cassiopeia''' has precisely {{as|20 '''bonus''' AP}} or {{as|40 '''bonus''' AP}}. In this scenario, ''Noxious Blast'' may inflict 1 less damage than intended. Importantly, this bug occurs independently of rounding considerations. * {{pending for test}} Enemies within the blast of ''Noxious Blast'' are {{tip|poison|poisoned}} for something between {{fd|3.2}} and {{fd|3.3}} seconds. }}

{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Twin Fang|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Cassiopeia
|skill        = E
|icon         = Twin Fang.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Cassiopeia}} launches an attack at the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}}. If this attack kills the target, the {{sti|{{as|mana cost}}}} is refunded.
|blurb2       = Against a {{tip|Poison|poisoned}} target, the attack deals increased damage and {{tip|heal|heals}} her.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Cassiopeia''' launches her fangs at the target enemy that deal {{pplevel|50 to 120|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}}. If this kills the target, ''Twin Fang's'' {{as|{{sti|mana|mana cost}}}} is refunded.
|description2 = Against a {{tip|poison|poisoned}} target, ''Twin Fang'' deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} and {{tip|heals}} '''Cassiopeia'''. The heal is reduced by 75% against {{tip|minions}} and small and medium {{tip|monsters}}.
|leveling2    = {{st|Bonus Magic Damage|{{ap|20 to 120}} {{as|(+ 45% AP)}}|Total Enhanced Damage|{{pp|50 to 118}} (+ {{ap|20 to 120}}) {{as|(+ {{ap|45+20}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Heal|{{as|{{ap|10 to 16}}% AP}}|Reduced Heal|{{as|{{ap|10*0.25 to 16*0.25}}% AP}}}}
|target range = {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|700|BUG: Displayed range, 765, is slightly larger than the real range}}
|speed        = 2500
|cooldown     = {{fd|0.75}}
|cast time    = {{fd|0.125}}
|cost         = 45
|costtype     = Mana
|queue time   = {{fd|0.35}}
|targeting    = Unit
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Magic
|spelleffects = spell
|spellshield  = True
|projectile   = True
|callforhelp  = True
|knockdown    = 
|grounded     = 
|notes        = 
* Upon reaching the target, ''Twin Fang'' will wait for an ongoing {{ai|Noxious Blast|Cassiopeia}} to explode before dealing its damage.
* ''Twin Fang's'' damage against poisoned targets:
** When maxed first: {{pplevel|52+20;56+20;60+40;64+40;68+60;72+60;76+80;80+80;84+100 to 120+100 for 10;100 + 52 + (120-52)/17*(18+x-1)}} {{as|(+ 65% AP)}}.
** When maxed second: {{pplevel|52+20;56+20;60+20;64+20;68+20;72+20;76+20;80+40;84+40;88+60;92+60;96+80;100+100 to 120+100 for 6;100 + 52 + (120-52)/17*(18+x-1)}} {{as|(+ 65% AP)}}.
** When maxed last: {{pplevel|52+20 to 100+20 for 13;104+40;108+60;112+60;116+80;120+100;100 + 52 + (120-52)/17*(18+x-1)}} {{as|(+ 65% AP)}}.
* ''Twin Fang's'' cast indicator is incorrectly adding her own radius to the range like an {{tip|edge range}} ability, and is therefore slightly larger than the actual cast range ''Twin Fang'' can cast at.
* Using ''Twin Fang'' on an out-of-range target after completing a movement order causes '''Cassiopeia''' to move back to her original location after casting, if no other order is issued during the entire process.{{bug|2}}
** This may be a consequence of ''Twing Fang'' being a "Walk in range of the target" ability that does not interrupt movement commands.
{{Unit-targeted cancel conditions}}
|tips         = 
* Because 700 {{tip|centered range}} is equal to [ 700{{minus}}65{{minus}}65 = 570 ] {{tip|edge range}} (where 65 is the typical champion [[size]]) which is close to her {{sti|basic attack range}} of 550 units, and because her movement orders are not interrupted when ''Twin Fang'' is cast, ''Twin Fang'' allows the player to continue [[kiting]] effectively and repeatedly.
}}
